title_en: Do you know, girl, do you remember
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: 'Ливаѓе' is my reading (meadow or fruit-garden). The final stanza is read as bitter irony: he will arrive still teased by dogs and girls.

lines.en: Do you know, girl, do you remember
when we were together, girl, in the meadow?
When we were together, girl, in the meadow,
in the meadow, girl, under the poplars?

lines.cyr: Сите пари моме ми ги зеде
lines.lat: Site pari mome mi gi zede
lines.en: You took all my money, girl,

lines.cyr: без пет пари моме ме остави.
lines.lat: bez pet pari mome me ostavi.
lines.en: and left me without five coins, girl.

lines.cyr: Дај ми малку моме од парите
lines.lat: Daj mi malku mome od parite
lines.en: Give me a little, girl, of the money

lines.cyr: да си купам моме брза коња.
lines.lat: da si kupam mome brza konja.
lines.en: so I can buy, girl, a fast horse.

lines.cyr: Да си купам моме брза коња
lines.lat: Da si kupam mome brza konja
lines.en: So I can buy, girl, a fast horse

lines.cyr: да не одам моме пеш до село.
lines.lat: da ne odam mome peš do selo.
lines.en: so I don't go, girl, on foot to the village.
So the dogs, girl, bark at me

lines.cyr: а момите моме да се смејат.
lines.lat: a momite mome da se smejat.
